items.translation: `org.springframework.scheduling.quartz` 包中 `MethodInvokingJobDetailFactoryBean.MethodInvokingJob` 的用法

items.source: Support classes for the open source scheduler Quartz, allowing to set up Quartz Schedulers, JobDetails and Triggers as beans in a Spring context.
items.translation: 支持开源调度器 Quartz 的类，允许在 Spring 上下文中将 Quartz Scheduler、JobDetails 和 Triggers 配置为 Bean。

items.source: Extension of the MethodInvokingJob, implementing the StatefulJob interface.
items.translation: 扩展了 MethodInvokingJob 并实现了 StatefulJob 接口。
